title: The deprecated `privateMint()` prone to many issues
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `privateMint()` is marked as a deprecated function. However, this function is prone to several issues:  1. The `splitSignature()`, which is only used for `privateMint()`, does not work with short signatures (64-length signature):    [link](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2098)  2. The direct value for USD+ minting (`usdPlusAmount`) is used without performing oracle conversion to reflect the real amount especially when the paymentToken is not USD+ (e.g., USDC, which also has permit functionalities).
